text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Kawakami Princess is convinced that it's her fault Sweep Tosho's peer decided to quit running.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This is because Kawakami Princess bumped into her when they were running together. Kawakami Princess remains afraid of putting anyone else through a similar experience.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The experience has even become a source of trauma for her, but Sweep Tosho identifies her attitude as something else in need of a scolding.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Everyone races knowing they could get injured. It's time to remind Kawakami Princess what really matters when it comes to racing!
